high_level_description: The image is a slide from a presentation with a light blue background. It features a quote by Erwin Schrödinger from 1943, which reads: "How can the events in space and time which take place within the spatial boundary of a living organism be accounted for by physics and chemistry?" The quote is attributed to Schrödinger and is presented in a serif font. Below the quote, there is a diagram illustrating the concept of a Markov blanket as a statistical boundary. The diagram consists of a network of nodes connected by arrows, representing a directed acyclic graph (DAG). The nodes are color-coded
